get.description: Liveness check for the frontend and the uptime monitor. No auth.

Readiness for the uptime monitor: the database answers and the worker's heartbeat
is recent. 503 otherwise, with what is wrong. No auth; reveals no data.

post.description:
Validate a strategy config without saving it. Returns it with defaults applied;
an invalid body gets a 422 listing every error.

Validate the theses config without saving it. Returns it with defaults applied;
an invalid body gets a 422 listing every error.

get.description: Every saved version of a domain, newest first; the active one is flagged.
What changed from one version to another (any two versions of the domain).

post.description:
Make an old version current again by saving its body as a new active version. The
next run of every job uses it. 409 if the old body no longer passes validation.

get.description:
Every domain's active version in one file, to keep config in git or move it to
another project.

post.description:
Validate every domain of an exported file, then save them all as new active
versions. Any invalid domain rejects the whole file with every error listed (422) and
nothing saved.

get.description:
Totals, allocation, drift against the active strategy, and freshness, from the
latest snapshot. Returns empty sections (not an error) before the first sync.
Every open position of the latest snapshot, largest first.

Orders, dividends and cash movements, newest first, with totals per type and
currency over every row matching the filters (dates are UTC days, both inclusive).

post.description:
Queue a portfolio sync now. The worker runs it; a run already in progress finishes
first (the job waits for it), so two syncs never write at the same time.

Queue an earnings thesis check for one holding: find the release, extract and
validate its figures, then judge the thesis KPIs.

Re-judge thesis KPIs from the stored facts with the active theses config. No
fetching, no model calls: use it after editing a threshold.
Refresh every holding's next report date now.

get.description:
One holding: position, thesis, KPI verdicts with their history, and every extracted
fact with its source.

The archived copy of the page a fact was read from: a short-lived signed URL and
the text around the fact's snippet.

post.description:
Release or reject a fact the validator held for review (sanity bound, restatement,
currency). Verdicts for the holding are re-run afterwards.

put.description: Validate and save as the new active strategy. Drift uses it immediately.

get.description: The saved job schedules. 404 means the worker runs on the defaults.

get.description:
News items, newest first, each with its story's severity and confidence. Filters
combine (AND); a repeated parameter matches any of its values.
The fixed event taxonomy, for labels and filters.
Recent alert decisions: sent, held for quiet hours, suppressed (with why) or failed.

post.description:
Route a test alert through the active notification rules exactly as a real event
would be (quiet hours included; the daily cap and repeat throttle do not apply). The
worker sends it within seconds, or when quiet hours end.

get.description: A digest with every sentence's citations and the source list.

total_value.title: Total Value
total_value.description: Total value as Trading212 reports it.

cache_write_multiplier.title: Cache Write Multiplier
cache_write_multiplier.description: Cache-write tokens cost this times the input price.

cache_read_multiplier.description: Cache-read tokens cost this times the input price.

batch_multiplier.title: Batch Multiplier
batch_multiplier.description: Batch API requests cost this times the token price (searches excluded).

CategoryWeightRule.title: CategoryWeightRule
CategoryWeightRule.description: Limit on a category's weight; with no bucket it applies to every bucket of the dimension.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Active version per config domain (strategy, theses, jobs, ...).

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Number of changed paths against the previous version; null for the first.

dropped_sentences.title: Dropped Sentences
dropped_sentences.description: Written sentences removed because they cited nothing given.

use_batch.title: Use Batch
use_batch.description: Write the summary through the Batch API (half price).

batch_wait_minutes.title: Batch Wait Minutes
batch_wait_minutes.description: How long to wait for the batch before writing the summary directly.

min_severity_summarised.title: Min Severity Summarised
min_severity_summarised.description: Stories at or above this severity get a written summary; the rest are listed by headline.

news_item_ids.title: News Item Ids
news_item_ids.description: The story's items, lead item first.

model.title: Model
model.description: Reads report dates off IR calendar pages.

EarningsCalendarSettings.title: EarningsCalendarSettings
EarningsCalendarSettings.description: Next report dates: Finnhub for US issuers, the IR calendar page otherwise.

report_date.title: Report Date
report_date.description: Report date to look for. Default: the instrument's report date if it has passed, else today.

url.title: Url
url.description: Use this document instead of searching (a press release or report).

locate_model.title: Locate Model
locate_model.description: Searches for the release when EDGAR has none (non-US issuers).

max_steps.title: Max Steps
max_steps.description: Claude calls plus document fetches per run.

check_days_after_report.title: Check Days After Report
check_days_after_report.description: Days after the report date on which the check runs until it finds the release (the spec's +1, retry at +2 and +4).

EarningsCheckSettings.title: EarningsCheckSettings
EarningsCheckSettings.description: The earnings thesis check: find the release, extract figures, validate, judge KPIs.

severities.title: Severities
severities.description: Severity per event type; a type left out keeps its default.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: Per-holding severity for one event type.

escalate_when_thesis_linked.title: Escalate When Thesis Linked
escalate_when_thesis_linked.description: Event types raised one level (max 3) when the item touches a thesis KPI or exit condition.

insider_cluster_count.title: Insider Cluster Count
insider_cluster_count.description: Insider transactions for one holding within the window that count as cluster buying or selling (raised to severity 2).

recycled_after_days.title: Recycled After Days
recycled_after_days.description: An item whose event happened this long before it was published is a recycled story: shown, never alerted.

thesis_breach_severity.title: Thesis Breach Severity
thesis_breach_severity.description: Severity of an alert for a KPI breach found by an earnings check (0: never alert, the digest still lists it).

earnings_check_on.title: Earnings Check On
earnings_check_on.description: Confirmed stories of these types queue an earnings thesis check for the holding, unless one ran in the last 10 days.

evidence_url.title: Evidence Url
evidence_url.description: Signed URL of the archived copy, valid 10 minutes.

context.title: Context
context.description: The archived text around the snippet.

synced_at.title: Synced At
synced_at.description: When the sync that wrote this snapshot finished its last step.

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: Base-currency units per one unit of `currency`.

ppl.title: Ppl
ppl.description: Unrealised P/L in the account currency (Trading212).

position.description: Null when the latest sync has no position.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Other and former names, used to match news.

results_urls.title: Results Urls
results_urls.description: Pages where results press releases or reports are published.

financial_calendar_url.title: Financial Calendar Url
financial_calendar_url.description: IR financial calendar page with upcoming report dates.

extra_domains.title: Extra Domains
extra_domains.description: Further domains the earnings check may search and fetch from (the IR and results URLs' domains are always allowed).

sec_cik.title: Sec Cik
sec_cik.description: SEC Central Index Key. US issuers (8-K) and foreign issuers that furnish results on 6-K. Looked up from the ticker when empty.

sec_ticker.title: Sec Ticker
sec_ticker.description: Ticker as EDGAR and Finnhub list it, when it differs from the Trading212 ticker's prefix.

fiscal_year_end_month.title: Fiscal Year End Month
fiscal_year_end_month.description: Month the fiscal year ends in (Apple: 9, Microsoft: 6). Maps fiscal quarters to calendar periods.

reporting_currency.title: Reporting Currency
reporting_currency.description: Currency the company reports in; figures in another are held.

HoldingProfilesConfig.title: HoldingProfilesConfig
HoldingProfilesConfig.description: All holding profiles. Stored as `config_version` rows, domain `holding_profiles`.

holdings.title: Holdings
holdings.description: Every open position once, by value descending.

unchanged.title: Unchanged
unchanged.description: Domains whose body equalled the active version.

cron.title: Cron
cron.description: Standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday).

portfolio_sync.description: Trading212 sync, FX rates and drift. Default: daily at 22:30 Prague time.

earnings_calendar.description: Refresh every holding's next report date. Default: Sundays 06:00.

earnings_due.description: Queue earnings checks for holdings that reported. Default: daily 08:00.

news_ingest.description: Ingest, classify, corroborate and alert. Default: every 2 h, 06:00-22:00.

daily_digest.description: Daily digest of the last 24 h. Default: weekdays 07:00.

weekly_digest.description: Weekly digest of the last 7 days. Default: Sundays 18:00.

JobsConfig.title: JobsConfig
JobsConfig.description:
Schedules for the worker's timed jobs. Stored as `config_version` rows, domain `jobs`.

The worker re-reads this every few minutes, so a saved change applies without a restart.

history.title: History
history.description: Latest verdict per period, newest first.

next_before_id.title: Next Before Id
next_before_id.description: Pass as before_id for the next page.

corroboration_rounds.title: Corroboration Rounds
corroboration_rounds.description: Corroboration searches per story: one when it is first seen, the rest spread over the re-check window.

recheck_hours.title: Recheck Hours
recheck_hours.description: How long an unconfirmed story is re-checked.

NewsSettings.title: NewsSettings
NewsSettings.description: The news pipeline after ingest: classification, corroboration.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: 1: the company, regulators, central banks, official newswires. 2: curated outlets. 3: blogs and social (labelled sentiment, never alert alone).

type.title: Type
type.description: rss: an RSS or Atom feed. page: a news page read daily; new links on it become items. edgar: every holding's SEC filings. finnhub: US company news. google_news: a Google News query per holding (unofficial endpoint).

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Holdings this source is about (e.g. a company's own IR feed): its items link to them without a name match. Empty: items are matched by name.

domain_tiers.title: Domain Tiers
domain_tiers.description: Trust tier per outlet domain (subdomains included). Every holding's IR and results domains count as tier 1.

blocked_domains.title: Blocked Domains
blocked_domains.description: Items from these outlets are dropped.

unknown_outlet_tier.title: Unknown Outlet Tier
unknown_outlet_tier.description: Tier for an aggregator's item from an outlet not listed above.

include_tier3.title: Include Tier3
include_tier3.description: Keep tier-3 items (labelled sentiment; they never alert on their own).

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Where a matching event is sent immediately.

during_quiet_hours.title: During Quiet Hours
during_quiet_hours.description: hold_until_end: send when quiet hours end. send: send anyway. digest_only: do not send; it appears in the next digest.

daily_alert_cap.title: Daily Alert Cap
daily_alert_cap.description: Most alerts sent per day (in the quiet-hours timezone); the rest wait for the digest. Null: no cap.

repeat_throttle_hours.title: Repeat Throttle Hours
repeat_throttle_hours.description: Another story with the same holding and event type within this many hours of an alert is not alerted again.

digest_channels.title: Digest Channels
digest_channels.description: Where the daily and weekly digests go.

freshness.description: Null until the first successful sync.

last_sync.description: The latest sync job, whatever its status.

base_currency_mismatch.title: Base Currency Mismatch
base_currency_mismatch.description: The active strategy's base currency differs from the snapshot's; the next sync converts to the new one.

band.title: Band
band.description: Allowed absolute deviation from the target, as a fraction (0.02 = ±2 pp).

hard_limit.title: Hard Limit
hard_limit.description: Weight above which the position raises an alert, not just a digest flag.

PositionWeightRule.title: PositionWeightRule
PositionWeightRule.description: Limit on a single position's weight; with no ticker it applies to every position.

base_currency.title: Base Currency
base_currency.description: Currency every value is converted to for the overview and allocation.

fx_source.title: Fx Source
fx_source.description: Reference FX rates. Defaults to ČNB for a CZK base currency, ECB otherwise.

weight_basis.title: Weight Basis
weight_basis.description: 'total' weighs positions against positions plus cash; 'invested' against positions only.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free-text guidance the AI reads; never evaluated by code.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Allocation dimensions. 'currency' is derived from the instrument unless a classification overrides it.

classifications.title: Classifications
classifications.description: Bucket per dimension for each holding, e.g. {'ASML_EQ': {'sector': 'Semis'}}.

StrategyConfig.title: StrategyConfig
StrategyConfig.description:
The owner's investment strategy.

Stored as the body of `config_version` rows with domain `strategy`.

band.title: Band
band.description: Allowed absolute deviation from the target, as a fraction (0.02 = ±2 pp).

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Which rule matched and what happens.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Channels the alert is queued for.

ThesesConfig.title: ThesesConfig
ThesesConfig.description: All theses. Stored as the body of `config_version` rows, domain `theses`.

exit_conditions.title: Exit Conditions
exit_conditions.description: Conditions that would end the thesis, in plain words.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: Metric name the extraction job looks for.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: What the threshold is in: '%', 'x', 'count', or a currency with an optional scale ('EUR bn', 'USD m', 'USD' for per-share amounts).

ThesisKPI.title: ThesisKPI
ThesisKPI.description: An absolute threshold the owner sets. v1 has no consensus-estimate comparisons.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: One holding, or all when null.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Sum of `amount` over the filtered rows.

total_count.title: Total Count
total_count.description: Rows matching the filters, across all pages.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: Sums per type, subtype and currency over every matching row.

dividends.title: Dividends
dividends.description: Dividend sums per currency over every matching row.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next (older) page; null on the last page.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: Judged under an older theses config than the active one; re-run verdicts.

sanity_max_change_qoq.title: Sanity Max Change Qoq
sanity_max_change_qoq.description: A figure that moves more than this fraction against the previous quarter's verified figure is held for review (0.5 = ±50 %). Null disables.

sanity_overrides.title: Sanity Overrides
sanity_overrides.description: Per-metric band replacing the default; null disables the bound for that metric (e.g. seasonal or often sign-changing figures).

stated_ratio_tolerance_pp.title: Stated Ratio Tolerance Pp
stated_ratio_tolerance_pp.description: How far (in percentage points) a ratio the document states may differ from the one recomputed from its raw figures before the stated one is rejected.

period_end_tolerance_days.title: Period End Tolerance Days
period_end_tolerance_days.description: Slack between a stated period end and the calendar month end expected from the fiscal year end (52/53-week fiscal years end on a weekday, not month end).

max_report_lag_days.title: Max Report Lag Days
max_report_lag_days.description: Latest a release may come out after the end of the period it reports.
